lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Teacher.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I heard you're going to be coming to our school.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: At least,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: that's what I've heard.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: There's supposed to be a famous Commander coming to work as a substitute teacher at our school.
How did you know?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I have my sources, hee-hee.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm not a first year student here, y'know.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's not even my second year.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's my third year here!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: One.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Two.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: THREE!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Three is waaaaaay bigger than one or two.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's on a totally different level,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: and that's the highest in the school.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: So basically, what I'm saying is,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I've got plenty of access to information.
... I think she needs to get taken down a peg.
My assignment as a substitute is supposed to be top secret.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It is?
Absolutely. Extremely classified, as per the Central Government.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Wowee!
So I want to know how you came across this information.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Uh, well...
You do realize that stealing classified information is a crime, don't you?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I mean...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What I meant was... I just imagined it.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Yeah, that's it.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I was just thinking about how cool it'd be if a super-famous Commander

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: came and taught at our school for a bit.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It was all in my head, hehe.
So you imagined all of it?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Yep, every last bit.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: But... are you actually gonna be a substitute here?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: If you are, then I'm super stoked!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm already in my third year here,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I've gotta start conducting myself like a senior student.
I look forward to seeing you improve.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's taken me ages to get where I am.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: There's so much that I wanna do.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Like my homework for example, which I need to get started on.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: See you later, Teacher.
Something tells me this assignment won't be a walk in the park...
